This is EXACTLY what it says it is, we set it at the end of the island in our 5th wheel, it was a great addition. It holds our coffee machine, an ice maker and a toaster oven on the shelf below, smaller drawer, holds lots of coffee pods, lower area behind the door is nice too. I WOULD BUY THIS AGAIN. Easy to assemble, even a couple extra parts, in case you lose one. Good price too.

I'm really pleased with how this turned out—it's both attractive and incredibly versatile. The wheels glide smoothly, making it effortless to move around, and the whole piece feels solid and sturdy. The pull-down cabinet opens with a gentle, controlled motion, and the leaf is simple to maneuver, locks securely in place, so there's no worry about it slipping. Every part fits together snugly and operates smoothly. It took some time to assemble, but I managed to put it together on by myself.

Made a bedroom+bath in our house into a studio apartment for my mother. This is her “kitchen”. There were several styles and sizes of tables to choose from. This one fit perfectly and has checked all the boxes for her. Her utensils are sorted in the drawer. She has room to store plates and mugs in the cabinet below. I notice in other reviews people said they had trouble aligning the cabinet doors, but you Have to follow the printed instructions. Don’t just wing it. There are little screw spots you can turn left/right that adjust the doors down to the millimeter! So I was able to get the doors just how I wanted.

So far very good, capable coffee cart. A good height for pouring coffee and filling with water. Missing 4 screw to assemble drawer but fortunately the instructions give the size of the screws so I will try to find them locally. So far very pleased with the purchase and the delivery was very fast.

I like how this cart works in my kitchen, and it is solid. The cart is easy to move around when needed. In addition, the instructions for assembly for this cart were understandable and the cart fit together well during the installation process.
Nopea toimitus ja helppo koota. Hintaansa nähden laadukkaan oloinen ja nätti.
Perfect set up for my Studio apartment, I have gotten a lot of use out of it
Would buy again, perfect little island cart for our kitchen.
The kitchen island is easy to move with wheels, is fully enclosed for hygiene, and offers ample storage.

The product came disassembled all in one giant box. Everything was packed nicely and no damaged from shipping. Opened up and staged all the parts and hardware, then the directions said it would take 4 hours to assemble. I am an assembly expert and this product still took me 3 and 1/2 hrs to assemble. Once fully assembled, it is beautiful and a good solid center piece in our kitchen. Would easily recommend to anyone who is looking for an island kitchen. Only negative, the sliding drawers do not open up to the full length of the drawer. Great product and price!
Takes awhile to assemble, about 4hrs but everything was where is should be and finishes up nice.
Solid product. We ended up using it as a workstation for a 3D printer. I highly recommend, if you're uses for something heavy, reinforce the top.
Fantastic kitchen island. Strong and relatively easy to put together

Could have been 5 stars but the box came damaged and a few pieces were damaged as well. Nothing that kept it from being put together but definitely took some touch up paint to get it not noticeable. Over all it’s cute and provides me with the extra storage I needed. The end draws are super small and I wish it had casters on it so it could easily be moved. Over all it’s cute and I’m happy with it. Did take about 6 hours to put together solo tho.

This is a nice unit that's fairly unique among the many out there. We've had it for 9 months, and while we it doesn't see frequent use it's good as new. Only complaint is the hardware: the drawer don't fully open due to short slides - especially bad on the end drawers - and the doors don't have anti-slam hinges. The side drawer is also not as long as it could be - there's still plenty of space behind it for a bigger one. Hinges are an easy upgrade but longer slides take some ingenuity. I used a 3d printer. All in all solid though, and I'd buy it again.
